story_titles: Incident pauses Palisades fuel loading; plant connected to switchyard
story_summaries: An incident involving a fuel assembly has paused the fuel loading process at the Palisades power plant in Covert, Mich., operator Holtec has acknowledged. Fuel loading began on August 30 as Palisades entered Mode 6, the refueling stage of the restart. The reactor core consists of 204 fuel assemblies that include new fuel and partially used fuel from the plant’s most recent operating cycles.
